stepTitle: Answer the following questions about Kernel Density Estimation (KDE).
stepBody: For kernel bandwidth \alpha, let the kernel centered at observation xi be K\alpha(x, xi), and the KDE estimated distribution be f\alpha(x). When there are $$n$$ datapoints in the KDE process, what is the correct expression of f\alpha(x) in terms of K\alpha(x, xi) and $$n$$?
